notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/40/1475674066-saf-foxdive-1.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

We've just released a new update for Seasons After Fall, with a few bug fixes and changes to how V-sync is handled.

[h1][b]Patch Notes 25967[/b][/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
[list][b]Settings[/b]
[*]V-sync is in "auto" mode by default. This mode deactivates V-sync if the framerate is too low, and reactivates it when it increases.      [/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][b]Blocking Issues[/b]
[*]Fix of a potential blocking issue with collisions (when you change the season, you’re now blocked by the first collision).
[*]You can’t go through the roots blocking already completed regions anymore.
[*]Fix of a rare issue with the automatic teleportation.[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list][*]Enhanced performances on animated objets to fix framerate fluctuation in some regions.[/list]

notes.title: Seasons After Fall now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472807362-saf-seasonslevels.gif[/img]

[b]Seasons After Fall is now available![/b]

This hand-drawn puzzle-adventure game lets you dive into a captivating universe, exploring a land governed by magic and nature. As a wild fox, you are sent on a perilous journey aided only by your ability to change the seasons at will, manipulating the gorgeous world and backed by an enchanting live string quartet.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LqjntWk4Yxo&feature=youtu.be
Discover the Launch Trailer, and see how Winter can freeze waterfalls, the rain from Spring raises water levels, and how Summer causes some plants to grow and extend. The power of nature is in your paws as you make your journey across this mysterious world full of strange flora and fauna. 

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472807447-seasons-after-fall-05.jpg[/img]

Each of the seasons have a drastic change on the environment: it is up to you to change the world and open new paths. The world of Seasons After Fall is overflowing with secrets - can you uncover the truth? 

[b]Seasons After Fall is now available![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366320

notes.title: Wot I Think: Seasons After Fall
notes.notes:
Seasons After Fall [official site] is Swing Swing Submarine’s addition to the slowly-expanding subgenre of platformers which feature foxes and charming artwork. Here you play as a spirit controlling a fox as you attempt to harness the power of the seasons at the bidding of a mysterious character. The main point of difference between Seasons After Fall and other pretty platformers is that you get to switch between seasons you’ve unlocked at will, which then changes elements of the puzzles. Here’s Wot I Think:

notes.notes:
We covered Seasons After Fall [official site] quite some time ago, but in case you missed out, it’s a pretty little platformer where you guide a fox on a spiritual journey through the seasons, and it came out on Friday.

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/36/1473349549-saf-foxdive-1.gif[/img]

Hey everyone! 

We're pleased to announce a new update for Seasons After Fall!

[h1][b]Patch Notes 25913[/b][/h1]

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Comprehension
[list][*]Better display of the activation symbol when solving the puzzle with the fireflies in the "Foliage" or "Pit".
[*]Better display of the surrounding when unrolling a travel ribbon. The camera will change the zoom out and move on a better path to better let you guess where the ribbon is located.
[*]Added a hint to help localize travel ribbon (small particles falling down from it).
[*]Added a very subtle hint for the bird achievement.[/list]
[*]Settings[list][*]Added new sliders in options for the Audio part! Now you can tweak "Music", "Voice" and "Sfx" separately.[/list][/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Controls[list][*]The season selection with the right stick should be less sensitive (was sometimes even selecting the wrong season).[/list]
[*]Visual[list][*]Better visual on water surfaces (in "Puddle" or "Pit" or the starting region). These surface we not using textures, just reflecting the surrounding.[/list]
[*]Blocking Issues[list][*]A crawler was able to break a horizontal breakable trunk but missing to seed a pine in "Ranges", making you stuck when coming back with the summer fragment. The pine not being seeded will block the progression. The game will auto fix if you had the issue.
[*]Exiting the game in "Cocoon" region after the 4th treasure having been given to you will create a blocking situation where the cutscene will not be played again when returning to the game, leading to a block. The game will auto fix if you had the issue.
[*]Exiting the game in "Quagmire" region while a jellyfish was targeting a puddle will lead to a block since the puddle will never be activated when you return to the game. The game will auto fix if you had the issue.[/list]
[*]Potential Blocking Issue[list][*]The "rain trees" were not always synchronised correctly with the water surface they belonged to. Leading to a rain tree always rejecting water, or the player being stuck forever on top of it (since the fox adopt a specific stuck animation).
[*]The crawler which flies could be stuck in an animation after being carried by a wind flow.[/list]
[*]Performances[list][*]A lot of small bad memory handling was leading the game to have some hiccup in some region ("Ranges" for sure).
[*]Improved performances on animated rigged objects (more optimisation to come in futur release) to avoid low framerate on region with a lot of rigged objets.[/list]
[*]Level design[list][*]Added a mushroom in "Pit" which will help you have a better flow when going back with the spring fragment.[/list]
[*]Animation[list][*]Avoid a crawler pine to stay too long at a given dash state to prevent it from being stuck in the air (still experimental fix).
[*]Horizontal breakable trunk not instant reacting after being hit by a snow ball.[/list]
[*]Settings[list][*]Controller texture was too bright, and a frame was appearing in the in game menu.
[*]Auto apply video settings when exiting the menu (avoid tu use the Apply entry that appears when a change is done but has to ba validated).[/list]
[*]Misc[list][*]Added missing people in credits[/list][/list]

More info about the update [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/366320/discussions/0/350540973994293107/#c350540974014343941]here[/url].

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/36/1473079924-saf-seasonchange-2.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

We're pleased to announce a quick update for Seasons After Fall! Its goal is mainly to fix an issue launching automatically the game in French.

We have another update coming next week which will focus on performance for those of you encountering lower framerate in some regions.

Here is today's patchlog:

[h1][b]Changelog 25780[/b][/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*]The game was sometimes starting in french! Now the game should start in the language of your Steam Client. You can always change the voice and text language in the Settings.
[*]The game was launching in 720p (or worst!) on first launch. Now it will start in the native resolution of your screen. The resolution can be then changed in the Settings.
[*]Fix of several typos in credits and texts.
[*]Fix of a potential blocking issue if you quit the game in a given section of the game after gathering one or more runes.
[*]Small Level Art fix.[/list]

[b]Feature[/b]
[list][*]It's not possible anymore to quit or come back to the main menu during a cutscene (you can still pause it). We'll improve this in the future but, for now, it avoids some issues when you load a save after leaving during a cutscene moving objects.[/list]

More info about the update [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/366320/discussions/0/350540973994293107/]here[/url].

notes.title: Watch the Gamescom Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/33/1471508792-saf-titlescreen.gif[/img]

[b]We are pleased to unveil the Gamescom Trailer of Seasons After Fall, our atmospheric story-driven puzzle platformer due this September on PC.[/b]

Enter a world ruled by nature and magic as a wild fox with a fantastic ability: a supernatural control over the seasons to shape the environment and progress in this mystical adventure. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Xl-_29S_uE

The Gamescom Trailer tells you more about the story and the enigmatic spirit that will guide your way along your adventure. This spirit is in search of the fragments of the Seasons and needs an envoy to meet the Guardians of the Seasons, large ancestral creatures who embody the essence of the Season they are protecting. 

You need to gather these fragments to complete the Ritual of the Seasons, allowing this mysterious spirit to realize her dreams... and yours as well. 

Use your ability to change the seasons and manipulate the world around you. Use the rain from Spring to raise water levels, then the cold of Winter to freeze it up, granting you safe passage. Become entranced by the charms of this contemplative and poetic adventure, inhabited by the bewitching melodies of a string quartet. 

[b]Seasons After Fall will release this September and is now available for pre-purchase on Steam at 15% off.[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366320

notes.notes:
Seasons after Fall is Now Available for Pre-Purchase on Steam and is 15% off!

Seasons After Fall is a 2D puzzle-adventure game that will let you dive into a captivating universe and explore a land governed by magic and nature. As a wild fox you are sent on a perilous journey aided only by your ability to change the seasons at will, manipulating a gorgeous 2D world backed by an enchanting live string quartet.

The power of nature is in your paws as you make your journey across this mysterious world full of strange flora and fauna. Each of the seasons have a drastic change on the environment: it is up to you to change the world and open new paths.
